summary: Completed testing of remaining frontend flows for EcoAndes clone (iteration 12). Verified bug fix: CategoryCarousel now correctly calls /products/categories (no 404). Tested checkout flow (B2C), blocked shipping zones, blog, admin dashboard, and language switching. Most features working correctly with one minor UI issue (cookie banner overlay).

ui_bugs.issue: Cookie banner overlay intercepts clicks on payment method selection, preventing user from selecting Transfer payment method
ui_bugs.impact: User cannot complete checkout flow with Transfer payment method until cookie banner is dismissed
ui_bugs.workaround: User must dismiss cookie banner first before selecting payment method
